sr.opening: Obraćam Vam se u ime kompanije {organization} povodom mogućnosti saradnje sa kompanijom {company}.
sr.meetingOpening: Predlažem kratak poslovni razgovor kako bismo razmotrili {topic} i utvrdili da li naš predlog odgovara Vašim potrebama.
sr.informationOpening: Kako bismo pripremili relevantan i precizan predlog za {company}, bilo bi nam korisno da bolje razumemo Vaše zahteve.
sr.proposalOpening: Želeli bismo da Vam predstavimo okvirni predlog saradnje u vezi sa temom: {topic}.
sr.replyOpening: Hvala Vam na javljanju i interesovanju za saradnju sa kompanijom {organization}.
sr.followOpening: Javljam Vam se u vezi sa temom: {topic}. Voleli bismo da čujemo Vaše mišljenje o mogućnosti saradnje i dogovorimo naredni korak.
sr.meetingCta: Da li Vam odgovara razgovor u terminu {meetingTime}? Ukoliko taj termin nije pogodan, molim Vas da predložite drugi koji Vam više odgovara.
sr.meetingCtaDefault: Da li biste bili dostupni za kratak razgovor? Molim Vas da predložite termin koji Vam odgovara; način održavanja možemo prilagoditi Vašim mogućnostima.
sr.informationCta: Molim Vas da podelite osnovne zahteve, očekivani obim i željeni vremenski okvir. Na osnovu tih informacija možemo definisati sadržaj predloga i naredne korake.
sr.proposalCta: Molim Vas za komentar na navedeni predlog i informaciju o tome da li postoji potreba za dodatnim pojašnjenjima. Detalje i eventualne izmene možemo usaglasiti kroz kratak razgovor.
sr.introductionCta: Ukoliko je ova tema relevantna za Vaše poslovanje, rado bismo dogovorili kratak uvodni razgovor. Ako je za ovu oblast nadležna druga osoba, biće nam korisna informacija kome možemo da se obratimo.
sr.replyPlaceholder: [Unesite konkretan odgovor na pitanja klijenta pre slanja.]
sr.thanks: Hvala Vam na vremenu. Stojim Vam na raspolaganju za dodatne informacije.

en.opening: I am contacting you on behalf of {organization} to explore an opportunity to work with {company}.
en.meetingOpening: I would like to suggest a short discussion about {topic} to establish whether our proposal is relevant to your requirements.
en.informationOpening: To prepare a relevant and precise proposal for {company}, we would appreciate a clearer understanding of your requirements.
en.proposalOpening: We would like to outline a cooperation proposal regarding {topic}.
en.replyOpening: Thank you for getting in touch and for your interest in working with {organization}.
en.followOpening: I am getting in touch regarding {topic}. We would welcome your feedback on potential cooperation and an opportunity to agree on the next step.
en.meetingCta: Would {meetingTime} be convenient for a short discussion? If not, please suggest an alternative time that works for you.
en.meetingCtaDefault: Would you be available for a short discussion? Please suggest a convenient time; we can adapt the meeting format to your preferences.
en.informationCta: Please share your key requirements, expected scope and preferred timeline. These details will help us define the proposal and appropriate next steps.
en.proposalCta: We would appreciate your feedback on the proposal and any points that need clarification. We can discuss the details and any adjustments in a short meeting.
en.introductionCta: If this is relevant to your business, we would welcome a short introductory conversation. If another colleague is responsible for this area, please let us know whom we should contact.
en.replyPlaceholder: [Add a specific answer to the client's questions before sending.]
en.thanks: Thank you for your time. Please feel free to contact me if you need any further information.
